title: Explicit Scope and Stateless Elicitation
service: scopegate: a stateless MCP 2026-07-28 notes server with explicit workspace scope, a form-confirmed notes_delete, one-time nonces in memory and in SQLite, a URL-mode connector and nested workspace grants

parts.lesson_anchor: The three-layer rule (prefix confusion and encoded traversal); Capability Negotiation Is Per Request; Protecting Destructive MRTR State (bounded, TTL-pruned replay store); code/main.py uri_within_workspace, supports_form_elicitation, ReplayStore
planted_bugs: uri_within_workspace compares paths with str.startswith, so file:///work/notes-evil/q3-report.md is inside file:///work/notes; it surfaces two calls up, as an extra candidate from NoteBook.matching
file_uri_parts normalizes before it percent-decodes, so %2e%2e and %2f only become .. and / after normpath has run, and /work/notes/../private.md counts as inside
supports_form_elicitation reads elicitation.get('form', {}), so the default makes a URL-only declaration look like form support
ReplayStore.claim_and_consume rebuilds the whole consumed dict on every claim to drop expired nonces, O(n) per claim and quadratic over many live nonces
parts.timing_assert: 10000 claims with every nonce still live, under 0.12 s (the rebuilding version takes 1.4 to 2.4 s on a loaded machine, the expiry heap 3 to 11 ms)
parts.overfix_guard: a full store refuses a new nonce and still refuses a replay of a live one, which rules out evicting the oldest entry; a nonce claimed first but expiring later must not block one claimed later that expires first, which rules out pruning in insertion order; expiry at exactly now frees the slot; a claim whose operation fails stays unconsumed; containment must decode exactly once (%252e%252e), accept %20, accept a .. that stays inside, keep the workspace itself and the root workspace inside, and compare hosts; form support keeps the empty declaration and does not let a declared url cancel form; a full store refuses exactly at max_entries, and a replay of a live nonce is reported as a replay even when the store is full
parts.deviation: The suggested 20000 claims would make the quadratic version run 5 s or more, past the 3 s ceiling, so the timing uses 10000 live nonces. The first failure surfaces through NoteBook.matching (the in-memory candidate search), not through the server, because the server's notes_delete is Part 3's work.

parts.lesson_anchor: Protecting Destructive MRTR State: a production database should couple the nonce claim and mutation in one transaction; Exercises 1 and 3 (SQLite replay store, re-check containment inside the mutation transaction, two processes cannot both commit)
parts.exactness: claims come back as {nonce: expires_at} exactly, including 1290.123456789 and 1000.5, from the other process and after a reopen; a claim kept to the sub-second is still refused at 1000.0 when its state expires at 1000.5
traps: check-then-insert race, exposed by a third connection holding BEGIN IMMEDIATE while both retries arrive
INSERT OR IGNORE without the row count, or INSERT OR REPLACE

autocommit connection, lastrowid instead of rowcount, busy timeout 0
parts.deviation: The notes table and its accessors are given, so the part is about the claimed-nonce table and the shared transaction. Two server processes are simulated by NoteDB instances on their own connections, two of them in worker threads.

parts.lesson_anchor: Elicitation Still Exists, but Delivery Changed; Form Mode; Response Branches; Protecting Destructive MRTR State (signed candidate set, live re-check before mutation, decline terminal, cancel and malformed answers retryable); code/main.py tools_call and _delete_note_once

parts.integration: a note moved to file:///work/notes/%2e%2e/outbox/ after the form was shown needs Part 1's decoding to be refused; two NotesServer objects share the NoteBook and the ReplayStore

parts.lesson_anchor: URL Mode (show the full destination, consent before opening, no prefetch, accept does not prove completion, bind the browser user to the principal); Response Branches; Exercise 2
parts.wire_format: NDJSON client action log (show_url, open, retry, complete, refused), decided by the test's join, endswith('\n'), splitlines and json.loads; the test also records how many ticks were pulled when each line arrived

parts.deviation: The URL-mode server (ReportConnector) is given except browser_callback, which carries the browser-user binding. Out-of-band completion is simulated by the test calling browser_callback between ticks; ticks stand for the moments the user says they are back. The -32021 data for a missing URL capability, {'elicitation': {'url': {}}}, follows the shape the lesson gives for form mode.

parts.lesson_anchor: The three-layer rule, Authorization layer (is this principal allowed to use this workspace); Two Problems That Look Similar (a client-provided folder is not proof the caller may delete everything inside it)
traps: string-prefix matching

parts.deviation: Same-workspace allows add up (read plus delete is delete) and only deny overrides; the lesson does not name this, so it is stated in the GrantTree docstring and the clarifying answers. The tree is plugged into the Part 3 server at the end.
